headline: Should Lockheed's AI-Driven Fighter Autonomy Tests Reshape the Next-Gen Defense Narrative for LMT Investors?
summary: In recent tests, Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works, the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School and partners used an AI agent on the X-62 VISTA to autonomously execute 27 live air intercepts using real-time sensor data. This move from simulated to sensor-driven, in-flight AI decision-making highlights how Lockheed Martin is working to embed advanced autonomy into future combat aircraft operations. headline: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift After Analyst Target Increases
summary: Lockheed Martin is back in focus as analysts lift price targets into the US$590 to US$700 range following the latest Q2 update and refreshed models. Recent Street commentary links these higher targets to views on improving execution, a raised 2026 outlook and mixed but constructive signals around contract momentum and sector headwinds.
